Chapter 205: Chapter 8: Double Protection (Please Subscribe)

“`

“Heiyu Ao, you’d better exert yourself…”

“Best send over a Sixth-Rank Evolver team for me to crush to death.”

“Then I can openly step in and save my little junior brother from danger… With that, wouldn’t he be utterly moved… boo hoo hoo…”

“`

Lazily leaning against a roadside chair, the bald man relished the thought in his mind.

...

Given his status, he could naturally warn the Heiyu Family directly.

But doing so… would not fulfill his little junior brother’s request to continue training on Canglan Star for a few more years.

A direct warning from a Red Kun Lineage Great Peak Master would certainly draw extensive scrutiny from powers within this Star Domain and the surrounding ones.

For instance—

What exactly happened that prompted a Great Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage to personally step forward and warn the Heiyu Family?

It turned out to be Heiyu Mo’s little son.

Such an insignificant figure, why would he catch the attention of a Great Peak Master?

Oh… it’s because this little son is using the Heiyu Family’s influence to suppress a talented Evolver named Lin Yuan on Canglan Star.

A mere Middle-grade Life Planet talent Evolver, how could he draw the attention of a dignified Red Kun Lineage Great Peak Master?

Once this conclusion is reached, it will definitely lead some to speculate whether Lin Yuan’s true identity might be related to the Thirteenth Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage.

Or even… could he actually be the Thirteenth Peak Master?

Of course, the above speculation might simply be one of many possibilities.

However, as it concerns the mysterious Thirteenth Peak Master, even a mere possibility or speculation, once known by Different Species, will not be overlooked.

They would rather erroneously kill than allow the potential Thirteenth Peak Master to rise.

Of course.

The bald man could also warn the Heiyu Family and Heiyu Mo in secret.

But if Heiyu Ao makes an illogical reaction afterward, such as suddenly sparing Lin Yuan or suddenly being recalled to the Heiyu Family,

It will still provoke reactions from the outside world, those ‘Divination’ Class Evolvers will deduce useful information from minor news reports.

And furthermore.

The bald man didn’t fully trust the Heiyu Family; if he warned them in secret, external forces wouldn’t know, but the Heiyu Family would definitely be aware, right?

What if they started harboring other thoughts…

Thus, for the bald man, the most secure method was to personally stay on Canglan Star.

As long as he was there, no matter what changes occurred outside, even if Canglan Star collapsed and the nearby Constellation System was destroyed, he was confident he could ensure his little junior brother would not suffer any harm.

Although his current body was a recently consolidated Avatar, it was not much weaker than his original self.

And since he had never revealed it before, the outside world was also unaware of this Avatar, using it to protect his little junior brother, nor would some crafty ‘Divination’ Class Evolvers notice anything.

…

Central Continent Manor.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in the underground training area.

“It’s a pity.”

“Since I uploaded the ‘Fifth Rank’ chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the Goddess of Wisdom took the initiative to unlock my information blockade and forged a normal growth trajectory…”

Lin Yuan sighed.

A blockade of information is both a protection and a warning.

If someone wanted to deal with Lin Yuan and then check the information, finding it blocked would undoubtedly make them cautious.

But for a citizen under an information blockade, if their significance exceeds a certain limit, then the information blockade has the flavor of giving oneself away.

Indeed, citizens under information blockade are not limited to founders of evolutionary paths; there are talents in evolution, culinary arts, science research, art domains, and so on.

But today’s Martial Arts Evolutionaries, having the potential to advance to the Eighth Layer, means that Lin Yuan may become a new Evolution Scholar in the future.

Such important talent, if still under information blockade, once people look into it, would certainly draw attention and become a bit risky.

How to truly protect a talent?

That is to make this talent indistinguishable from ordinary people.

Even if others checked Lin Yuan’s information, they would only see the information made up by the Goddess of Wisdom, thinking that Lin Yuan is just an ordinary Fourth Rank Evolver with potential, who may have a chance to step into the Fifth Rank in the future.

Nothing more.

As such, even if targeted, he wouldn’t attract too much attention, not worth the Different Species paying a high price to assassinate.

Of course, an Evolver important enough for the Goddess of Wisdom to personally forge information would definitely be arranged for other protective measures.

…

On the other side of Canglan Star.

A man of dwarfish stature was savoring gourmet food.

“Ah… this planet may be backward, but the food is not bad.”

The dwarfish man strolled casually, startling numerous young, beautiful female citizens who scurried away in fright.

“What’s the matter?”

“Never seen a member of the Demonic Mouse Race before?”

The dwarfish man puffed out his round belly, utterly unconcerned.

The Demonic Mouse Race… one of the starbound ethnic groups that fully submitted to Human Civilization, had completely integrated into the Human Race over millions of years; however, they are still quite rare on some Middle-grade Life Planets.

“The females on this planet really don’t meet my standards, not nearly as adorable as those little potatoes from the Demonic Mouse Race…”

After walking a bit, the dwarfish man stopped and glanced in the direction of the Central Mainland from afar.

“The Goddess of Wisdom has gone to great lengths to protect that person, forcibly transferring me from the border battlefield to carry out a secret mission, coming to this planet incognito as a bodyguard…”

The dwarfish man sighed.

He, a Seventh-Rank Peak existence, even on the border battlefield, could revel in slaughter, truly imposing. But now, he had to roam aimlessly on a Middle-grade Life Planet.
